movie.title: Fight Against Evil 3
movie.overview: Li Hongqi is forced to travel for his wedding but must team up with a local cop to rescue a girl from human traffickers, fighting criminals while racing against his wedding date.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: En route to his own wedding, officer Li Hongqi is forced to team up with a local cop to bust a human trafficking ring before time runs out.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Li Hongqi is forced to travel for his upcoming wedding, expecting a straightforward journey to his big day. However, his plans are derailed when he uncovers a ruthless human trafficking network targeting a young girl. Teaming up with a local police officer, Li must use his combat skills and wits to take down the criminals. Balancing high-stakes action with comedic chaos, he faces a desperate race against time to save the girl and make it to the altar on time.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Li Hongqi sets out on a journey to attend his own wedding, looking forward to a joyous occasion and a break from his dangerous law enforcement life. His plans take a sudden detour when he stumbles upon clues leading to a dangerous human trafficking ring operating in the region. Unwilling to turn a blind eye to a victim in peril, Li decides to intervene and rescue a young girl who has been abducted by the syndicate. To navigate the unfamiliar territory and track down the kidnappers, he forms an uneasy partnership with a local police officer. Together, the mismatched duo must battle their way through ruthless enforcement goons, hidden criminal hideouts, and constant set-backs. Throughout the investigation, high-intensity martial arts combat and action sequences collide with the comedic tension of Li constantly checking his watch. The traffickers prove to be far more organized and dangerous than initially anticipated, raising the stakes for everyone involved. As the deadline for his wedding rapidly approaches, Li pushes his physical and mental limits to neutralize the syndicate's leadership. Ultimately, he leads a decisive raid to free the abducted girl and bring the perpetrators to justice. With the criminal threat neutralized, Li embarks on a mad dash to reach his bride before his wedding date slips away entirely.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Fight Against Evil 3 follows officer Li Hongqi as his personal life and professional duty clash in an action-packed race against time. While traveling for his wedding, Li crosses paths with a local police officer after uncovering a sinister human trafficking operation that has kidnapped a young girl. Forced into action, Li must navigate an unfamiliar city, engage in intense combat against hardened criminals, and overcome unexpected comedic hurdles, all while striving to save the innocent victim and reach his bride before it is too late.
